module_summary: State machine that shifts input into 24-bit window and detects completion based on one-hot phase tracker.

anchors.name: oh
anchors.why: One-hot FSM state; cycles HUNT/MID0/MID1/FIN to track 3-cycle pipeline.

anchors.name: win
anchors.why: 24-bit shift register window; accumulates 3 input bytes.

anchors.name: in
anchors.why: 8-bit input data; fed into shift register every cycle.

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Completion flag; asserted when oh[FIN] reaches final state.

anchors.name: out_bytes
anchors.why: Output data; 24-bit window when done, else undefined.

anchors.name: mk
anchors.why: Mask from input bit[3]; gates state machine transitions.

anchors.name: go_mid
anchors.why: Transition signal; asserted when HUNT/FIN and mk valid.

groups.name: FSM State Machine
groups.description: One-hot state tracker with 3-cycle pipeline sequencing.

groups.name: Data Accumulator
groups.description: Shift register accumulating 3 input bytes into 24-bit window.
